lines.speaker: A
lines.english: What are you making for dinner?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Zuò yú, hái yào zuò mǐfàn.
lines.english: Cook fish, and make rice too.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Jiālǐ yǒu cài, bù yòng mǎi.
lines.english: We have vegetables at home, so no need to buy.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ lái bāng nǐ zuòfàn.
lines.english: Then I'll come and help you cook.
